segments.name: Home retail
segments.description: An omni-channel specialty retailer of high-quality products for the home, selling merchandise through e-commerce websites, direct-mail catalogs, retail stores and business-to-business.
segments.evidence: Because they share similar economic and other qualitative characteristics, we have aggregated our operating segments into a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for merchandise purchased through its e-commerce websites, direct-mail catalogs and retail stores, including shipping fees for home delivery.
revenueModel.evidence: Our single reportable segment derives revenues from sales of merchandise through our e-commerce websites, direct-mail catalogs and retail stores, and includes shipping fees received from customers for delivery of merchandise to their homes.
